Mr Niaz Ullah Khan Niazi, Advocate General, ICT.
body: Mr Qasim Wadud, Addl. Attorney General. Syed Muhammad Tayyab, Dy. Attorney General. Rana Waqar Anwar, Addl. District Magistrate, ICT. Mr Sadiq Ali Dogar, DIG (HQs), ICT Police. Mr Muhamamd Riaz Inspector (Legal), ICT Police. The learned counsel for the petitioner, after arguing the matter at length, has stated that he does not press the petition and that remedies available under the law would be availed before the learned trial court. He has, however, stated that the petitioner reserves his right to file a fresh petition. The petition is, therefore, dismissed as not pressed. However, the petitioner would be at liberty to file a fresh petition, if so advised.
